name: io.github.dkaleganov/qbo-multicompany-mcp
description: Unofficial read-only MCP server for several QuickBooks Online company files in one AI session.

packageArguments.name: --entities
packageArguments.description: Path to your private entities.yaml: one entry per company, with its key, display_name, realm_id and environment. Connect each company first with qbo-multicompany-mcp-auth (see the README).

packageArguments.name: --env-file
packageArguments.description: Optional private dotenv file, read only when this flag is passed. A variable already set in the environment wins over the file.

environmentVariables.name: QBO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your own Intuit app, here or in the --env-file file. A value set here, even a blank one, overrides --env-file.

environmentVariables.name: QBO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client Secret of your own Intuit app, here or in the --env-file file. A value set here, even a blank one, overrides --env-file.

environmentVariables.name: QBO_ENV
environmentVariables.description: sandbox or production; sandbox when unset. A value set here, even a blank one, overrides --env-file.

environmentVariables.name: QBO_TOKEN_KEY_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Where the token store key lives: keychain (the default, macOS only) or env (QBO_TOKEN_KEY). A value set here, even a blank one, overrides --env-file.

environmentVariables.name: QBO_TOKEN_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The store key when QBO_TOKEN_KEY_SOURCE=env: 32 bytes as 44 characters of base64 or 64 of hex. A value set here, even a blank one, overrides --env-file.

environmentVariables.name: QBO_TOKEN_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Token store directory. Defaults to $XDG_STATE_HOME/qbo-multicompany-mcp, else ~/.local/state/qbo-multicompany-mcp. A git working copy or a cloud-sync folder is refused. A value set here, even a blank one, overrides --env-file.

environmentVariables.name: QBO_ALLOW_DOCUMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register get_attachment, which fetches nothing until QBO_ATTACHMENT_HOSTS pins a host. Off by default. A value set here, even a blank one, overrides --env-file.

environmentVariables.name: QBO_ATTACHMENT_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated storage hosts attachment downloads may contact. Empty refuses every download. A value set here, even a blank one, overrides --env-file.
